rationale.overall: A more closely echoes the reference’s tactile, irregular surface treatment and dimensional lighting.
rationale.material: A has slightly richer texture variation, softer light falloff, and more convincing translucency in the loop.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes use essentially the same block, loop, and diagonal-ground geometry.
rationale.smallsize: Both reduce to nearly identical, equally legible dark-block and orange-edge reads at 128px, 32px, and 16px.
